findings.location: whole module (dispatch_subtask at line 76) — production-orphan kept alive only by its own tests
findings.finding: The module's docstring advertises 'Phase 6 upgrade: capability-tag dispatch ... new agents inserted via SQL get dispatched with zero code change' and calls pick_agent_by_tag 'the proof point'. In reality the module has zero importers anywhere outside tests/ — production agent selection flows through app/fleet/fleet_manager.py::FleetManager.select() (fleet_manager.py:78) and app/api/specialized_agents.py's _REGISTRY/_discover_agent_fn (dynamic run_* discovery from AGENT_CONTRACT). get_agent_for_type() and pick_agent_by_tag() are called only from within dispatch_subtask() itself.
findings.evidence: grep -rn 'pipeline.dispatcher' app/ -> 0 hits; total non-test occurrences of dispatch_subtask = 0 (only tests/test_dispatcher.py:7 and tests/test_agent_registry.py:129); docstring claim in dispatcher.py:1-15; docs/reports/PHASE_4_TEST_REPORT.md, PHASE_6_TEST_REPORT.md, AUDIT_01_ARCHITECTURE.md reference the module.
findings.production_impact: None at runtime (dead path). Maintenance hazard: its tests pass forever regardless of production routing, and the docstring's dispatch claim is false for the shipped system.
findings.recommendation: Delete the module and its tests, or actually wire capability-tag dispatch in and remove the duplicated concerns from FleetManager.select.

verified_clean_summary: Hallucination enforcement is mechanized, not aspirational: the quality gate's passed value includes checks.get('policy:schema_valid', True) at base_graph.py:2387, so schema-invalid submit_* payloads deterministically flip _requires_human_approval; the citation checker feeds _citation_check plus a telemetry counter; VerificationConfigs enforce tool-evidence (git_diff->diff_reviewed with enforce_in_result; bug-fix read-before-edit via blocking_until) across 94 instantiations.

Hardcoding: agent model map lives in app/fleet/agent_models.json (85 agents incl. ux_design_agent/mobile_dev/agentic_ai_architect at lines 87-98); all operational constants are config.py fields; zero hardcoded secrets; name-equality branches only where dispatch genuinely branches.
Prompt/context leakage: per-run AgentRunState; per-session chat memory with bounded restore; secret env redaction in the bash tool; no cross-agent or cross-tenant context bleed found.

Infinite loops: all 4 while True sites bounded; the agent graph cannot spin — stall counter (base_graph.py:3365, threshold 3366-3368, max_stalls default 3) forces checkpoint+escalate+human review at run end (4235-4270); no recursion_limit override relies on the LangGraph default as backstop.

Circular dependencies: 496 modules scanned; only 1 pure top-level cycle (event_bus package re-export pattern, benign via submodule fallback); all other 97 cycle groups contain deliberate deferred imports; app imports cleanly.
Module graph has ZERO orphan module files: the reachability scan found every dotted app.x.y module name imported somewhere in backend/**/*.py (min 1 occurrence outside its own file).

Test-only scan false positives correctly classified and excluded: FastAPI route handlers (decorator-registered, e.g. activate_repo repo.py:386-387, get_artifact_route artifacts.py:37-38), dynamically-dispatched agent run_* modules (specialized_agents.py:200-227 _discover_agent_fn imports app.agents.<name> and requires a unique run_* from the module with AGENT_CONTRACT), and standard test-reset helpers (reset_for_testing, reset_client, reset_docker_probe_cache, reset_model_router, reset_orchestration_time_stats, reset_rq_adapter, reset_local_for_tests all used by tests).

Audit 13's error-contract exception handlers are live: http_exception_handler and validation_exception_handler are registered via @app.exception_handler decorators (main.py:1939-1953), not dead code as the name-occurrence count alone would suggest.

Silent-exception sampling: agent-switch telemetry (manager.py:573,750,832), chat reader-thread and model-router fallback (chat_agent.py:496,966), stream-push guards (pm.py:127, decomposer.py:146), flag housekeeping (tasks.py:59) — all deliberate, documented, and non-critical to correctness; sites that matter log exc_info=True.
